source.title: Thread (Korean): a provider named constructor became an Object function string, the alias lookup fixed in PR #772

manifest.reason: A three-post Korean explainer of the model attribution bug fixed in SlopDotCash/slopdotcash#772: a plain PROVIDER_ALIASES[name] lookup returned the inherited Object constructor for a provider literally named constructor, so the models summary showed a function string. It shows the Object.hasOwn fix, the cases checked (constructor, Constructor, existing OpenAI and Z.ai aliases, unregistered names) and says the change is metadata only, not model performance. A worked example of the prototype-key pitfall for contributors who map names with plain objects; separate from the merged PR, which already scored on its own.

source.title: Thread (Korean): GH_TOKEN set but gh authentication is unavailable, the loader order fixed in PR #770

manifest.reason: A four-post Korean explainer of the ingestion credential bug fixed in SlopDotCash/slopdotcash#770: the loader skipped GH_TOKEN and fell straight to the GitHub CLI, so a machine without gh could not start even with a valid token. It lists the corrected read order (trimmed GITHUB_TOKEN, then GH_TOKEN, then gh), the four isolated regression cases, and the boundary of what the public PR proved (config loading up to the GraphQL request, not live authentication). It separates a token error from a loader error for readers hitting the same message, and it is separate from the merged PR, which already scored on its own.

source.title: Thread (Korean): why brand:check fails on a Windows checkout and how PR #722 fixed it

manifest.reason: A five-post Korean explainer of the Windows checkout failure fixed in SlopDotCash/slopdotcash#722: core.autocrlf rewrote LF to CRLF so brand:check compared different bytes, the fix was a .gitattributes rule rather than a looser check, the thread quotes the before and after byte comparison (687 of 700 files differed, then 0) and tells readers to compare a fresh checkout against Git bytes instead of disabling the check. It also states what the fix does not prove. The explainer is separate from the merged PR, which already scored on its own.
